entities.notes: Police and security force of Vatican City State, part of the Directorate for Security Services and Civil Protection under the Governatorate. vaticanstate.va site blocks automated fetching; no public mailbox evidenced.

entities.name_native: Pontificia Cohors Helvetica / Guardia Svizzera Pontificia

evidence.note: Official site (recruitment/communications run from the Swiss foundation domain); contact page renders contacts via script, no plain-text email found — registrable domain assumed

entities.notes: Armed corps protecting the Pope and the Apostolic Palace; closest to a military/guard force of the Holy See. Internal Vatican addresses likely under Vatican domains (vatican.va/scv.va) but not evidenced.

entities.name_native: Governatorato dello Stato della Città del Vaticano

evidence.note: Governatorato services historically publish addresses @scv.va (e.g. musei/servizi SCV); site blocks automated fetching so no live example captured — treated as the state's administrative mail namespace

entities.notes: Executive body of Vatican City State; nearest interior-ministry equivalent (security directorate reports to it). Holy See curial bodies use vatican.va instead.

gaps: No police category distinct from the Gendarmerie (gendarmerie covers policing).

No border guard, no intelligence service, no defence ministry, no cybersecurity agency/CERT as distinct public bodies (the Direzione delle Telecomunicazioni e dei Sistemi Informatici handles IT internally, no public natsec mandate evidenced).

Vatican web properties (vaticanstate.va, vatican.va, press.vatican.va) blocked or returned no email addresses to automated fetching; scv.va attribution based on the Governatorato's known mail namespace rather than a captured address — confidence capped at medium.
